subject: Proposal: Hosted API renewal + stepped commit increase (ParcelShift)
messages:
From: Matt Ruiz <matt.ruiz@parcelshift.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ellen.park@parcelshift.com, procurement@parcelshift.com
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal window + planned traffic lift for Q1

Hey Karthik,

We’ve been reviewing usage patterns for the last two quarters and we’re lining up a renewal conversation for early December. Long story short: we expect a 2.5x increase in steady-state tokens starting Jan 15th (new feature rollout), and would like to move to a stepped monthly commit that gives us predictable capacity and gentler soft-throttling.

High level asks:
- Increase hosted API monthly commit from current 1.2B tokens to 3B tokens across Q1 (staged: 1.8B Jan, 2.5B Feb, 3B Mar).
- Clear burst window for holiday promotions (we expect short spikes).
- Updated rate tiers for token pricing above commit thresholds.

Attached the draft SOW the procurement team asked for. Can we get a commercial outline + Ops runbook that includes onboarding, expected latency SLO, and a short-term burst plan?

Ideally we’d sign by Dec 10th to get engineering alignment.

Thanks,
Matt
Head of Product
ParcelShift

Attachment: ParcelShift_SOW_Q4_v2.pdf
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Matt Ruiz <matt.ruiz@parcelshift.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal window + planned traffic lift for Q1

Hi Matt —

Thanks for the context and the SOW. This is the kind of growth we designed our staged-commit path for. Short answer: we can support the staged increase and provide a burst pocket, but I want to align on a few specifics before we put numbers in the SOW:

1) Burst window sizing: are bursts expected to be sustained minutes-long spikes or high QPS for ~hours during promotions?
2) Token mix: what % is generation vs embeddings (affects unit economics and preferred model variants).
3) Latency SLO expectations for the new traffic shape (p50/p95 targets).

Kimberly — tagging you for pricing/terms and Marissa for onboarding/ops runbook.

I’ll draft a commercial outline with two options: (A) stepless commit uplift to 3B with fixed discounted tiers above commit, (B) staged commit ladder (1.8B / 2.5B / 3B) with a defined burst pocket and higher overage rates but a lower initial commit.

Can you give me the procurement contact for DocuSign routing?

- Karthik
Director, Growth — Redwood Inference

From: Matt Ruiz <matt.ruiz@parcelshift.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ellen.park@parcelshift.com, procurement@parcelshift.com
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal window + planned traffic lift for Q1

Hey Karthik —

Answers inline:
1) Bursts: short, high QPS (10–30 minutes) during promo events — we want a guaranteed cushion at the start of each promo and then a gradual fallback.
2) Token mix: ~78% generation (chat/completions), ~22% embeddings for search and similarity.
3) Latency: target p95 under 600ms for the high-volume endpoints.

Procurement for Docs — procurement@parcelshift.com. If you send a blackline and commercial they’ll route to legal.

We’d prefer Option B if the economics are reasonable. Also, can you note any model-variant fallbacks you’d recommend if you need to conserve capacity?

Matt

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Matt Ruiz <matt.ruiz@parcelshift.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: ParcelShift commercial: staged commit option + rate tiers (v1)

Matt / Team —

Following our sync, attached is a commercial summary and the proposed pricing spreadsheet. Key points:
- Staged commit (Option B): Jan 1.8B / Feb 2.5B / Mar 3.0B tokens. Monthly invoice cadence.
- Burst pocket: additional 300M tokens/month available for holiday promos with a 10% premium over overage rate; unused burst does not roll over.
- Overage tiers: up to 110% of current month commit = standard overage rate; 110%–150% = +15% rate; >150% = negotiated spot-rate (we’ll engage if sustained).
- Model fallbacks: we recommend a fallback policy to Redwood-verified quantized variants (e.g., redwood-qa-2q) for non-latency-critical paths; we will route with a grace period before automatic fallback.

I’ve attached the redwood_pricing_sheet_parcelshift.xlsx and a draft SOW (SOW_v1) that embeds these terms. If this looks good we can prepare a DocuSign envelope and route to procurement@parcelshift.com.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm burst sizing and sign-off on staged commit by Dec 7.
2) We send final SOW + DocuSign by Dec 8.
3) Once signed, Marissa will schedule the onboarding kickoff and a capacity-test window.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_sheet_parcelshift.xlsx, ParcelShift_SOW_Q4_v2.pdf

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Matt Ruiz <matt.ruiz@parcelshift.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@parcelshift.com, ellen.park@parcelshift.com
Date: Mon, 04 Dec 2028 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ParcelShift commercial: staged commit option + rate tiers (v1)

Kim —

Thanks — looks reasonable. Two quick asks before we sign:
1) Can we get a 30-day promo burst (separate one-off: 1B tokens) the first week after launch (Jan 15–Feb 15) to cover unexpected adoption? If it’s a one-off add-on with defined pricing we’ll likely accept.
2) For the >150% spot-rate, can you provide a not-to-exceed $/k-token guidance so procurement has a ceiling to evaluate?

If you can add those to the SOW, procurement will fast-track. We’re trying to keep to your Dec 10 target for signatures.

Matt

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: Matt Ruiz <matt.ruiz@parcelshift.com>, procurement@parcelshift.com, ellen.park@parcelshift.com
Date: Mon, 03 Dec 2028 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ParcelShift commercial: staged commit option + rate tiers (v1)

All —

Quick update to close the loop:
- Kim: can you add the 30-day one-off promo burst (1B tokens) with the proposed one-off price of $0.045 / k-token to the SOW and include a not-to-exceed spot-rate of $0.065 / k-token for sustained >150% usage? Those numbers are inline with our margin guardrails for a customer this size.
- Marissa: once the SOW is updated, please create the DocuSign envelope and include the HubSpot deal PSH-2028-09 link in the envelope notes. Also prep the onboarding checklist: 1) capacity smoke test, 2) KV/prefix cache recommendations, 3) routing fallback policy, 4) incident contact list.
- Matt & ParcelShift procurement: if you can confirm by EOD Dec 7 we’ll hit the Dec 10 sign target.

I’ll standby to expediate legal routing if procurement needs a quick call.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Growth — Redwood Inference
